adjudication.rationale: The diff makes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` an array and `handleNewBooking` can push multiple collective hosts’ destination calendars (`evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`). `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` then iterates each destination and calls `createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)`, but `CalendarManager.createEvent` only passes `credential.id` to the calendar service. Unlike `GoogleCalendarService`, `LarkCalendarService` does not select the destination calendar by `credentialId`; it always destructures the first entry (`const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []; const calendarId = mainHostDestinationCalendar?.externalId;`) in both `createEvent` and `createAttendees`. With multiple destination calendars, this will route creates/attendees to the first calendar’s externalId even when invoked for another host/credential, matching the reported broken behavior.
